caption:
does a pimple patch work on every spot?

Usually only on some. If there's a white head on top, a hydrocolloid patch can soak up what comes out.

If it's a deep, sore bump with nothing on the surface, there's little for the patch to absorb. It mostly covers the spot and keeps your fingers off it.

The evidence is still small: a 2006 pilot trial of 20 people found hydrocolloid patches reduced mild-to-moderate inflammatory acne more than plain tape over one week.
